audience: DeFi borrowers and liquidation bot operators on Stellar Soroban
problem_statement: Borrowers managing distressed positions during volatility often cannot reliably time defensive collateral deposits because sudden gas spikes price out or delay their transactions, triggering preventable liquidations.
angle: With Stellar ledger capacity usage at just 0.08 and the base fee resting at 100, deterministic execution costs eliminate fee-driven delays in liquidation timing, though thin secondary liquidity ($1.24M Soroswap TVL versus $157.16M Blend TVL) indicates the risk profile shifts from gas unpredictability to available market depth.
